description: Read the latest full audit: status, result card and report links. Quick checks are previews, not completed audits. A previous successful report is linked separately when the latest run has not completed. Reading starts nothing. `waitSeconds` waits up to 50 seconds for a running report.

domain.description: The Shopify storefront to check, e.g. example.com. Required until a store is connected; afterwards, omit it to use a connected store.

store.description: The connected store to use. Omit when only one is connected.

name: get_store_audit_result
title: Get audit result
